config.record_grain: One row per current Australian Financial Services licensee/register entry, including its AFS licence, supplied identifier, register-entry label and principal business address components.

fields.evidence: Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN; preview row 2 sample value 85007186003 is supplied in this column. The abn operation validates an 11-digit ABN and emits no value for a valid ACN.

Help File p.8 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is the licensee's ABN or ACN; preview row 2 sample value 85007186003 is supplied in this column. The acn operation validates a 9-digit ACN and emits no value for a valid ABN.
Help File p.9 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL is the locality of the current principal business address; preview row 2 header/sample is AFS_LIC_ADD_LOCAL=SOUTHBANK.
Help File p.10 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_STATE is the state of the current principal business address; preview row 2 sample is VIC.

Help File p.10 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_PCODE is the postcode of the current principal business address; preview row 2 sample is 3006. The source notes blanks/nulls can occur for unvalidated or non-Australian addresses.
Help File p.10 data dictionary: AFS_LIC_ADD_COUNTRY is the country of the principal business address and countries outside Australia are set to International; preview row 2 sample is Australia.

unmapped_fields.reason: Identifies the register, not an ontology legal entity, trading name, licence identifier, status, or other canonical field.
Unique AFS licence number, but the supplied ontology has no licence-number field; do not place it in an entity identifier field.
Register entry name retained via subject_label_field, but documentation calls it the licensee register entry name and does not establish that it is the legal name or trading name.
This is the date the AFS licence was issued/started (Help File p.8), not company registration; ontology has no licence start/effective-date field and it must not map to entity.date_registered.
Previous/superseded pre-FSR licence register identifiers and numbers (Help File p.9); ontology has no prior-licence field.
Current financial services/products authorised under the licence, including nested condition text (Help File p.11); ontology has no licence-condition or authorisation field.

limitations: This is a current-register snapshot according to Help File p.3, but no record-level observation timestamp is present; the source publication timestamp is therefore used as the observation proxy.
The source is a licence register and does not establish company deregistration, legal-entity status, branch structure, trading names, or reporting groups.
AFS_LIC_ABN_ACN is one mixed ABN/ACN source column; both mappings are intentional, and each validator emits only its applicable identifier without suffix inference.
The supplied principal-business address is mapped as a business address, not a registered office or service location.
AFS_LIC_NAME is retained as a raw subject label only; no canonical legal or trading name is asserted.
All authority and field-confidence scores are provisional and require human review.
The source envelope supplies publication timestamp and Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia licence; extraction must attach those envelope values plus source record traceability.
